Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezm Avenue, West Triangle. Quezon City http: ltwww. dilg.gov.ph 04 SEP DILG OPINION No. HON. JAMES MARTY L LIM Liga President Province of Marinduque EDEN C. PINEDA Liga President Tacloban City ABELARDO S. PANGILINAN Liga President Province of Occidental Mindoro MARIO SUBAGAN Liga President Province of Ilocos Sur Dear Hon. Lim, et.al.: This is in reference to your letter dated 15 August 2018 requesting this Department for legal opinion and reliefon the following issues which we quote in verbatim, to wit: 1. A.Vhether or not the duly elected HUC/ICC/Provincial Liga Presidents who were already issued confirmations for their Local Chapters and already have assumed their ex-officio functions be legally disqualified to vote and be voted upon the National Liga Elections for the unpaid/delinquent membership dues by their chapter which was incurred solely by its predecessors. 2. Whether or not the members of the National Liga Board (NEB) can continue to issue, promulgate orders, and institute amendments to election code inspite Of the fact that they are mere interim officials, who are currently composed of former national officials whose term as punong

barangay has expired? And can they be allowed to continue to implement and execute official acts of the Liga? Inspite of their lack of quorum, practicing grave misconduct and grave abuse of authority resulting to massive confusion and possible disenfranchisement of voters and candidates alike. 3. Whether or not an officer of the Liga who is no longer elected as punong barangay be allowed to continue as hold over? And that they still entitled to administer, receive honorarium and benefits in performance of official acts of position concerned. 4. Whether or not an officer of the Liga who has pending election case be qualified to run for election or reelection? Foremost, this Department observed that some Of the issues you raised were "internal Issues" and in our opinion, it should be addressed by the Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB) only. Example is your issue no. I on payment of Liga dues. It was duly provided by Section 3, Article VIII of the 2016 Liga Constitution and By-Laws (CBL) that "nxx the national executive board shall exercise the following powers and duties: (a) Promulgate such rules and regulations necessary to implement theprovisions ofthis Constitution and By-Laws such as but not limited to the rules on conduct and discipline, elections, and sanggunian representation; " Hence, this Department is guided by the pronouncement of the Supreme Court in the case of National Liga ng mga Barangay vs. Paredes, et al., which states: "These acts of the DILG went beyond the sphere of general supervision and constituted direct interference with the political affairs, not only of the Liga, but more importantly, of the barangay as an institution. tio f Li off is ('fth the latter has already provided guidelines In succession, the DILG assumed stewardship and jurisdiction over the Liga affairs, issued supplemental guidelines for the election, and nullified the effects of the Liga-conducted elections. " Based on the above discussions, we believe that interpretation of policies on LnB dues is within the power of the National Executive Board (NEB) and for them to decide and take action thereon. For issues no. 2 and 3, we should discuss them together as the issues are inter-related. G.R No. 130775. September 27, 2004

Notably, this Department is consistent in its stand on who shall be allowed to sit as officers of the LnB. This position was exemplified in DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2018- 992 which provides that: For purposes of the 2018 LnB Elections, the term "incumbent" or "incumbent LnB President" as mentioned in DILG MC No. 2018-90 shall mean the sitting LnB officials who were "re-elected" PBs during the May 14, 2018 Barangay Elections The term and tenure of all Barangay Officials shall only be until noon of June 30, 2018. Consequently, those who are no longer incumbents cannot sit as ex officio members in their respective Sanggunians. Based on this above-mentioned MC, it is this Department's view that hold-over provision in the LNB Constitution and By-Laws (CBL) shall be applicable only to those PB who were re-elected. Officers ofthe Liga who were not PB anymore at noon of June 30 2018 should not be allowed to continue their functions in the Liga. In addition, the PB who will act as "Ex-ofFcio"members in the Sanggunian should be an incumbent PB because being elected to the office of punong barangay is the basic requisite in order to be qualified as an ex-officio member. The term ex-officiomeans "from office; by virtue ofoffice. " It refers to an "authority derived from official character merely, not expressly conferred upon the individual character, but rather annexed to the official position. " Ex- officio likewise denotes an "act done in an official character, or as a consequence of office, and without any other appointment or authority than that conferred by the office.3 Based on the above definition, an ex officio member is holding the said position only by virtue of a certain office, like being elected as the Liga ng mga Barangay Chapter President. Therefore, ex officio membership is attached to an office not to the person holding the said office. It must be noted also that you will only become a Liga President by reason of having been elected as Punong Barangay. Thus, it is this Department's position that since it is explicit that the term of office of the barangay officials under the provision of RA 10952 shall commence at noon of June 30 next following their election4, it follows that the tenure as Punong Barangay will end in the 2 Clarificatory Guidelines To Memorandum Circular No. 2018-90, entitled: "Guidelines in the Conduct of the Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB) Chapter Elections at All Levels," dated June 21, 2018 3 Civil Liberties Union, vs. The Executive Secretary, G.R. No. 83896, February 22, 1991 'Section 2, RA 10952

noon of June 30. Therefore, those Liga Officials who were not re-elected should cease to act as an ex-offcio member of their respective Sangguniann and also should refrain from exercising duties and functions of an LnB Offcial. In issue no. 4, you asked whether or not an officer of the Liga who has a pending election case is allowed to run for election or re-election. The herein situation can be given two (2) interpretations. First, if he has an election case as a result of the May 14, 2018 Elections, we believe that he is still allowed to run for a position LnB because he is considered an incumbent PB pending the resolution of the case. Second, an election case as a consequence of LnB Elections. Corollary thereto, Article VI of the 2018 Election Code of Liga ng mga Barangay provides for the Qualifications of Candidates, viz: Section 1. A candidate for any elective position in all levels of the Liga shall: I. I Be a duly elected Punong Barangay; 1.2 Be a duly registered and accredited delegate to the election meeting; 1.3 Be of good moral character (not convicted) by finaljudgment ofcrimes involving moral turpitude; I. 4 Have not been removed from office in any level of the Liga on grounds provided under Section 3, Article XIIofthe Liga Constitution and ByLaws. Or, in the event of suspension, shall have been reinstated prior to said election; 1.5 Be a bonafide member of the Liga. Bonafide membership means that the Barangay being represented has been regularly remitting the required dues to all levels of the Liga, in accordance with the Liga Constitution. In relation to this above-mentioned provision of 2018 LnB Election Code, in your letter you opined that an officer with pending election case should not be qualified to run, citing this provision: "1.1.3. For the National Liga AND REGIONAL CHAPTER - a certified true copy ofthe Certificate of Canvass and Proclamation ofthe Provincial, Metropolitan, Highly Urbanized and Independent Component City Chapter elections duly attested by the Board of Election Supervisors (BES) in support of his/her election as Chapter President together with the certificate of confirmation from the National Liga to this effect. "

We disagree. Based of the above discussions, we find no justification from the LnB Constitution and By-Laws, as well as the 2018 LnB Election Code to prohibit an officer with pending election case to run in higher position, provided that he was duly proclaimed as winner, albeit the case. However, in this second situation, we believe that this issue is internal to the LnB and it has the power to decide herein. Nonetheless, pursuant to the power of general supervision of this Department over the LnB, it is recommended for the NEB to review the 2016 Constitution and By-Laws and other issuances, and amend the same, if necessary, in order to be consistent with the existing laws and policies. Lastly, this Department renders this opinion, and not a relief, on matters that are within the scope of its mandate. We hope we have addressed your concerns accordingly. BY Copy furnished: Office of the Liga ng mga Barangay Unit 1410 East Tower, PSE Center Tektite Bldg., Exchange Rd., Ortigas Center, Pasig City Very truly yo ORITY OF THE SE MARTIN B.
